description: NT DCIS - Remote Communities with Mobile Coverage (Point) 2019 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Northern Territory Government - Department of Corporate and Information Services. This dataset provides the GPS Co-ordinates and Backhaul Transmission Type of telecommunications services in remote areas of the Northern Territory. For more information please visit the Northern Territory Government Open Data Portal. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Northern Territory Government - Department of Corporate and Information Services. Its tags are environment. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
